t: This logic block can be placed with its input side facing an $(thing)energy block$(). It will show a digit representing the amount of power in that block, and it will also emit a redstone signal with that strength, ranging from 0 to 9.
这个逻辑方块可以放置，使其输入面朝向一个$(thing)能源方块$()。它会显示该方块中能量数量对应的数字，同时还会发出相同强度的红石信号，范围为 0 到 9。
